== Mechanically distinct hosts: Bill decision ==

Bill reviewed the Premiere and Coruscant faces and the shared official slip, then chose separate full host articles with existing IDs retained and Premiere first in comparisons. The Coruscant host adds Episode I and Coruscant icons, so the hosts are mechanically different despite sharing the slip. No card ID was reassigned. The engine source also retains separate host blueprints: 1271_21 maps to 601_195 and 1271_43 maps to 601_238; Premiere uses 601_196 / 601_239. The shared identity skill records this exception. The old generic reuse note was replaced with the sourced host comparison; family links remain.
